description: Unofficial Windows Terminal fork whose panes can render with ghostty's engine per-profile. Installs alongside stock Windows Terminal, with no MSIX signing/certificate trust required for the portable build.
notes: This release ships only the portable ZIP (no MSIX). No certificate install is needed — the .cer / Import-Certificate step in docs/install.md applies only to the MSIX path, which is not published for v0.2.9 because no signing certificate is configured. To enable the ghostty engine, add "engine": "ghostty" to a profile in settings.json (Ctrl+, → Open JSON file). The portable build keeps settings beside the exe via the bundled .portable marker; it has no Start menu entry or wtg.exe alias.
